Method of Attack: Cryptocurrency giveaway scam pretending to be from Tesla and John McAfee
Scam campaigns promoted on Twitter impersonating celebrities
Users are tricked into sending Bitcoin or Ethereum to scam addresses with false promise of receiving multiple times back
Fake Medium articles and fake comments used to increase legitimacy
No outgoing transactions back to senders, indicating victims lose funds
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Medium article titled 'Elon Musk - Official ETH and BTC Giveaway'
Promoted through Twitter accounts impersonating Elon Musk, John McAfee, and others
Impacted Systems: Users of Bitcoin and Ethereum cryptocurrency wallets
Twitter users exposed to scam tweets
Attack Vector: Social engineering via Twitter impersonation and fake websites
Cryptocurrency transactions sent to scam wallet addresses
